FAQ

Common Questions

Is it a subscription?

No. You pay once per game. There are no recurring charges, no monthly fees, and no hidden costs. Each game generation is a one-time purchase of $14.99.

Can I get a refund?

If generation fails or produces something fundamentally broken, yes. Contact us and we'll make it right. We stand behind the quality of every generated game.

How many games can I create?

As many as you want. Each game costs $14.99 to generate. There are no limits on how many games you can create.

Do I own the game?

Yes, 100%. The generated game and all its assets are yours. You can sell it, modify it, open-source it, or do anything you want with it. No royalties, no attribution required.

What engine does it use?

All games are built with Godot 4, an open-source game engine. You get the full project files so you can open them in the Godot editor and continue development.

How long does generation take?

Typically 15-30 minutes depending on complexity. You'll receive an email when your game is ready to download.

Ready to Build?

Describe your game idea and have a playable build in minutes.
